mapper.update: INSERT INTO congestion_hourly (station_name, hour_of_day, avg_congestion, sample_count) VALUES (#{stationName}, #{hourOfDay}, #{congestionLevel}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE avg_congestion = (avg_congestion * sample_count + #{congestionLevel}) / (sample_count + 1), sample_count = sample_count + 1, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT hour_of_day AS hourOfDay, avg_congestion AS avgCongestion, sample_count AS sampleCount FROM congestion_hourly WHERE station_name = #{stationName} ORDER BY hour_of_day
